marilyn-buchi.text: Per the Fullerton Observer's January 2025 board report, Buchi said the district needs transparent communication about bond projects going forward.

source.title: Fullerton Observer: Fullerton Joint Union High School District January 14 Board Meeting (Feb. 2025)

marilyn-buchi.text: Per the Fullerton Observer, Buchi sharply criticized California's Prop. 28 arts-funding requirements in January 2025, saying FJUHSD has always supported art instruction and that she wanted to make sure the district needs the personnel and classes it adds with the money.

source.title: Fullerton Observer: Fullerton Joint Union High School District January 14 Board Meeting (Feb. 2025)

marilyn-buchi.text: (2014) Endorsed by the Fullerton Secondary Teachers Organization and Rep. Ed Royce (R) in her at-large re-election race, per Ballotpedia.

amy-dudich.text: Endorsed by Supporters of Public Education Orange County (SOPE-OC), Western State Carpenters Union, Painters and Allied Trades DC 36, and Plumbers & Steamfitters Union 582.

source.title: Amy Dudich for FJUHSD Trustee Area 5

amy-dudich.text: Dudich says that as trustee she "will support teachers, expand student opportunities by preparing them for college or the workforce, ensure our schools remain safe, and advocate for access to the mental health resources students need to thrive."

source.title: Amy Dudich for FJUHSD Trustee Area 5

amy-dudich.text: Dudich lists fiscal responsibility as a priority: "Make sound financial decisions that protect educational programs."

source.title: Amy Dudich for FJUHSD Trustee Area 5

amy-dudich.text: Dudich wants to invest in modernizing classrooms, security and technology to support hands-on learning, STEM, the arts and innovative programs, and to build college and business partnerships for workforce preparation.

source.title: Amy Dudich for FJUHSD Trustee Area 5
